'''Surik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[biochemist]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Surik managed a small shop, also teaching the knowledge of biochemistry to others.
